description: The file defines the HomeFragment class, which represents the main home screen for an Android TV application. It manages a vertical scroll layout that includes a top navigation bar, a hero banner carousel, and horizontal rails for 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels'. It incorporates auto-scrolling for the hero carousel, focus management for D-pad navigation, and integrates with a ViewModel for data loading and UI state management.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment for the Android TV app's home screen, managing layout, focus, and data binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and repository for data management.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates and sets up the root view hierarchy, including compose and recycler sections.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Performs post-inflation setup, including focus requests and LiveData observation.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes auto-scroll for hero carousel and manages focus.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Subscribes to UI state LiveData for updating sections.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message and schedules a retry.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates continue watching rail with data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates TV channels rail with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Creates and adds the Compose-based top navigation bar with focus and navigation behavior.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Sets up the hero carousel with auto-scroll, focus, and peeking layout.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers the hero carousel at specified card index with animations.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Builds the Continue Watching horizontal list section.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Builds the TV Channels horizontal list section.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus and accessibility for the rails.
